cross_layer_contracts.rule: Every derived artifact references source artifact IDs and hashes.
Every decision references a rule ID/version or is explicitly marked manual.
Evidence status cannot be upgraded by orchestration alone.
Research analysis requires immutable dataset manifest.
Generalization requires a declared transport target and boundaries.
Reports preserve claim status, contradiction and limitations.
Safety blocks have precedence over promotion/adaptation.
Unknown data never silently becomes a positive value.
All module versions are captured at execution time.
